note: Synthetic demo cassette, written by hand: not recorded from YouTube. Replace it with real recordings via `utubot youtube-record` (owner only). It shows the cassette shape and lets tests and the offline dev-proxy mode run end to end without YouTube.

info.title: u·tubot recorded fixture demo
info.description: A hand-written stand-in for a real yt-dlp answer: metadata, format list and caption tables, with every URL stripped (they carry signed tokens).

track.text: {"events":[{"tStartMs":0,"segs":[{"utf8":"Welcome to the u·tubot fixture demo."}]},{"tStartMs":6000,"segs":[{"utf8":"This cassette was written by hand,"}]},{"tStartMs":11500,"segs":[{"utf8":"so no video was ever played to record it."}]},{"tStartMs":18000,"segs":[{"utf8":"Every URL a real recording carries is stripped:"}]},{"tStartMs":25000,"segs":[{"utf8":"they carry signed tokens and expire anyway."}]},{"tStartMs":33000,"segs":[{"utf8":"Record real cassettes with utubot youtube-record,"}]},{"tStartMs":40000,"segs":[{"utf8":"which only the owner may run."}]},{"tStartMs":47000,"segs":[{"utf8":"Tests and dev servers replay this file"}]},{"tStartMs":53000,"segs":[{"utf8":"instead of touching YouTube."}]}]}
